title: Customer Experience & Insights Analyst
text: Customer Experience & Insights Analyst at PwC (Melbourne, ; Full Time; salary: not stated). Flexible work options - work smarter and in a way that suits your lifestyle Continuous Learning & Developments opportunities available Based in our new Barangaroo office Join PwC's Consulting team as a Customer Experience & Insights Analyst and support our clients to deliver improved social, economic and commercial outcomes and re-build trust in society by putting the customer at the centre of the organisation. This means transforming the way services and products are designed, and delivering consistent and personalised experiences for customers through better use of data and analytics, technology and platforms. The Opportunity At PwC, we help Australian businesses, not-for-profits and governments create value and improve the way they work. Whether you?re improving healthcare, creating smarter cities or building Australia's start-up industry from the ground up, you'll build trust in society and solve important problems every day. The Consulting team helps bring this to life by working with our clients to help put the customer at the heart of their organisation and deliver differentiated experiences, which delight customers and result in improved commercial and societal outcomes. As the Customer Experience & Insights Analyst you will make an impact by supporting our clients to solve key issues relating to the customer, taking a hypothesis based approach to solving client problems. Success in this role does come down to a positive attitude, hard work and going the extra mile in order to achieve. But that's not all! You will: Develop customer and channel strategies, brand and product strategies, sales and service initiatives and profitable pricing strategies to support relevant client outcomes Identify improvements to the customer experience while balancing cost considerations by mapping customer journeys and undertaking operational assessments Customer research (both qualitative and quantitative) design, execution and analysis to help inform: strategic and operational improvements in customer experience Identify and interpret value drivers and areas of importance for customers through value proposition design, segmentation and data analysis Facilitate workshops and regular stakeholder engagement (i.e. through meetings, forums, presentations) Apply innovative thinking and creativity to extract and share insights with clients when writing reports and developing presentations to support senior stakeholder discussions Coach junior staff members both formally and informally About you The brief is simple... You are passionate about improving outcomes for our clients, their customers and the broader community. You will have worked in a consulting environment and/or worked in a strategic role where you will have synthesised complex information, undertaken detailed analysis, solved critical problems and worked collaboratively as part of a team. You will possess strong data analysis skills with the ability to solve complex problems, including the ability to interpret customer insights and customer data to draw meaningful conclusions. You thrive in a collaborative and innovative culture and want to join a firm that values problem solvers, the kind of people who reimagine the possible for their clients and key stakeholders. Those who have worked with you before can vouch for the fact you: Have an inquisitive mindset to explore problems and anticipate client needs, as well as identify new opportunities to execute their strategies Are able to think commercially and to contribute to engagement delivery, practice development and thought leadership Communicate with impact and enjoy building relationships with internal and external clients Sound like you? Read on. What we offer Working for Australia's largest professional services firm you'll join a global network spanning 157 countries that delivers meaningful outcomes for a wide range of clients. Our culture and benefits are the reason why we were recognised as Australia's number one workplace by LinkedIn. Our state of the art offices embrace the very best technology has to offer access to flexible work options. Our dress policy is flexible too - you choose what you wear based on the kind of work you do with your team and clients. Fostering an inclusive culture and embracing differences is at the centre of everything we do. At PwC, you will be empowered to be yourself and work with people from different backgrounds and points of view to achieve things you never thought possible. Get involved in our employee-led diversity networks (cultural, disability, LGBTI or gender equality) and benefit from our best-in-class policies such as 18 weeks maternity/paternity leave, flexible work and gender equity. Up for a challenge? We are committed to helping our people unleash their passion and potential. Hard work does not go unrewarded and industry best coaching, mentoring, training and development are ready and waiting. If you have a genuine desire to make a difference and want to surround yourself with like-minded, talented and driven individuals who strive to do the same, apply now. Sarah Cullen is the Recruitment Manager for the role. As the team experience high volumes of applications, we appreciate your patience to allow for a timely and fair process for all. The minimum base salary for this role is seventy eight thousand Australian dollars.
